```artifact
Feature: User Login and Administrator Functions

  Scenario: User can log in with valid credentials
  Given a valid username and password
  When the user attempts to log in
  Then the system should grant access

  Scenario Outline: Administering specialities and user management
  Given an administrator with valid credentials
  When the administrator performs actions
  Then the system should reflect changes

  Examples:
    | User Type | Action                                 | Expected Result                                  |
    | Admin      | Add Speciality                          | Speciality is added to the system                    |
    | Admin      | Create User                             | User is created in the system                        |
    | Admin      | Edit Speciality                          | Speciality is updated in the system                   |
    | Admin      | View/ Print Invoice                      | Invoice is displayed/printed                       |
    | Admin      | Back-ups                                | Back-up is created                                |
    | Admin      | Archive Patient Profiles               | Patient profiles are archived                       |

  Scenario: User cannot log in with invalid credentials
  Given an invalid username or password
  When the user attempts to log in
  Then the system should deny access

  Examples:
    | User Type | Action                                 | Expected Result                                  |
    | Admin      | Add Speciality with invalid credentials | Access denied                                      |
    | Admin      | Create User with invalid credentials   | Access denied                                      |
    | Admin      | Edit Speciality with invalid credentials | Access denied                                      |
    | Admin      | View/ Print Invoice with invalid credentials | Access denied                                      |
    | Admin      | Back-ups with invalid credentials       | Access denied                                      |
    | Admin      | Archive Patient Profiles with invalid credentials | Access denied                                      |

  Scenario: Administrator cannot perform actions with invalid credentials
  Given an administrator with invalid credentials
  When the administrator performs actions
  Then the system should deny access

  Examples:
    | Action                                 | Expected Result                                  |
    | Add Speciality with invalid credentials | Access denied                                      |
    | Create User with invalid credentials   | Access denied                                      |
    | Edit Speciality with invalid credentials | Access denied                                      |
    | View/ Print Invoice with invalid credentials | Access denied                                      |
    | Back-ups with invalid credentials       | Access denied                                      |
    | Archive Patient Profiles with invalid credentials | Access denied                                      |

Feature: Administrator System Management

  Scenario: Administrator can set up users and passwords
  Given an administrator with valid credentials
  When the administrator sets up users and passwords
  Then the system should allow user access

  Scenario Outline: Administering specialities and user management
  Given an administrator with valid credentials
  When the administrator performs actions
  Then the system should reflect changes

  Examples:
    | Action                                 | Expected Result                                  |
    | Add Speciality                          | Speciality is added to the system                    |
    | Create User                             | User is created in the system                        |
    | Edit Speciality                          | Speciality is updated in the system                   |
    | View/ Print Invoice                      | Invoice is displayed/printed                       |
    | Back-ups                                | Back-up is created                                |
    | Archive Patient Profiles               | Patient profiles are archived                       |

  Scenario: Administrator cannot set up users and passwords with invalid credentials
  Given an administrator with invalid credentials
  When the administrator sets up users and passwords
  Then the system should deny access

  Examples:
    | Action                                 | Expected Result                                  |
    | Add Speciality with invalid credentials | Access denied                                      |
    | Create User with invalid credentials   | Access denied                                      |
    | Edit Speciality with invalid credentials | Access denied                                      |
    | View/ Print Invoice with invalid credentials | Access denied                                      |
    | Back-ups with invalid credentials       | Access denied                                      |
    | Archive Patient Profiles with invalid credentials | Access denied                                      |

Feature: Speciality Management

  Scenario: Speciality can be added and updated
  Given an administrator with valid credentials
  When the administrator adds or updates a speciality
  Then the system should reflect changes

  Scenario Outline: Administering specialities and user management
  Given an administrator with valid credentials
  When the administrator performs actions
  Then the system should reflect changes

  Examples:
    | Action                                 | Expected Result                                  |
    | Add Speciality                          | Speciality is added to the system                    |
    | Edit Speciality                          | Speciality is updated in the system                   |

  Scenario: Speciality cannot be added or updated with invalid credentials
  Given an administrator with invalid credentials
  When the administrator adds or updates a speciality
  Then the system should deny access

  Examples:
    | Action                                 | Expected Result                                  |
    | Add Speciality with invalid credentials | Access denied                                      |
    | Edit Speciality with invalid credentials | Access denied                                      |

Feature: Patient Profile Management

  Scenario: Patient profiles can be archived
  Given an administrator with valid credentials
  When the administrator archives patient profiles
  Then the system should reflect changes

  Scenario Outline: Administering specialities and user management
  Given an administrator with valid credentials
  When the administrator performs actions
  Then the system should reflect changes

  Examples:
    | Action                                 | Expected Result                                  |
    | Archive Patient Profiles                 | Patient profiles are archived                       |

  Scenario: Patient profiles cannot be archived with invalid credentials
  Given an administrator with invalid credentials
  When the administrator archives patient profiles
  Then the system should deny access

  Examples:
    | Action                                 | Expected Result                                  |
    | Archive Patient Profiles with invalid credentials | Access denied                                      |
```
